Toucan 1.0.7

  • Toucan’s window keeps everything on screen when it’s made narrow: Structure’s tables and the Entity Map shrink to fit, and the page can no longer be pushed off the edge by the sidebar.
  • The sidebar stays between its narrowest and widest sizes, and can no longer be closed by dragging it too narrow.

Toucan 1.0.6

Please update every Mac before anyone adds an email address, phone number, IBAN or NI number to Replace in its own category (see below). Earlier versions of Toucan can’t open a client that has one.

  • Toucan works on one client at a time. Choose the client at the top of the sidebar: its pages are Overview, Structure and Recordings, and Toucan’s own pages (Settings, Activity, Global rules, Extensions, Team and About) are listed below them.
  • Structure is the one page for every name Toucan replaces or keeps, in groups such as Family and Trusts and companies, with Keep at the end. Each row shows the name, how many aliases it has, its category, its role and links, and its token.
  • Click a name on Structure to open its editor beside it. Change its category and aliases there, and give it a position or links to other names, such as “Owns 60% of Example Holdings Ltd”. Everything is saved as you make it, and Undo at the bottom of the page takes it back.
  • The Entity Map, at the top of Structure, draws a client’s structure from those links: the family together at the top, and trusts, companies and what they own below. It redraws as you add links. Click a box to edit it there. It shows tokens until you switch to Real, and Issues lists holdings that add up to more than 100%.
  • Export Map…, in the map’s ⋯ menu, saves it as a PDF in the firm’s style, a picture (PNG) or a drawing to edit (SVG), in the client’s Restored/Reports folder.
  • An email address, phone number, bank account number (IBAN) or NI number that Global rules miss, such as one written out in words, can be added to Replace in the EMAIL, PHONE, IBAN or NI category, so its token says what it is. They are listed on Structure under Contact details and numbers, with the ones Global rules found.
  • Transcript corrections on a client’s Recordings page has two tabs: Client, that client’s own rules, and Global, the rules for every client. The global list’s file and the Only when unsure setting are in Settings › Recording.
  • Activity shows the client chosen in the sidebar, with changes for everyone marked Global.

Toucan 1.0.5

  • Toucan learns from your corrections. When you correct a transcript, each change is suggested as a correction to keep: for everyone (Global), for that client only, or Ignore. Nothing is saved until you choose, and Undo takes the last choice back.
  • Each client has its own transcript corrections, for names the speech engine mishears. They’re applied with the global rules before a transcript is checked, and a name the client doesn’t know yet is added to Replace so it’s tokenised.
  • Edit a transcript in Toucan. Click Transcript on a recording’s row, then Edit. Saving holds it for checking, and Check and Tokenise Again replaces its copy in Tokenised.
  • A project’s page keeps its recordings together: Transcript corrections is now under Recordings, with the suggestions from your edits waiting at the top of the table. A change to what a rule wrote shows on that rule’s row, with Update.
  • A team project’s People is now a button on its page, beside Rename, and the page says how many people are on it.
